request.description: Parameters describing the report to generate.

hr.report.v1.ReportPayload.description: ReportPayload is a generated HR report.

data.description: Serialised report content (CSV, JSON, or PDF binary depending on format).

format.description: Format of the serialised data (json | csv | pdf).

generated_at.description: Unix timestamp when the report was generated.

report_type.description: Type of report that was generated.

hr.report.v1.ReportRequestPayload.description:
ReportRequestPayload describes the parameters for an HR report.
Report types: attendance | timesheet | leave_utilization | leave_calendar
| overtime | payroll_cost | headcount | turnover
| checklist_completion | performance_review_status

date_from.description: Start of the reporting period (ISO-8601 date).

date_to.description: End of the reporting period (ISO-8601 date).

department_id.description: Filter by department; absent to include all departments.

employee_id.description: Filter by employee; absent to include all employees.

location_id.description: Filter by location; absent to include all locations.

report_type.description: Type of report to generate (see report type constants above).
